decisions.reason: Selecting the Word-file-and-cover-letter documentation method does not change the existing technical review scope, review source, or review purpose.
The method selection does not change the requirement for a PE stamp or the selected PE identity and license; the stamp placement and cover letter are owned by the concurrence-format Requirement.
The selected concurrence-documentation method concerns the separate as-built review task and does not alter calculations required for the permit-drawing project.
Choosing to stamp the as-built Word file and prepare a cover letter does not change the separate deliverable of permit-ready electrical drawings.
The source decision applies to the as-built concurrence package, not the separate California PE endorsement of permit-ready electrical drawings.
The as-built concurrence-documentation choice does not affect HVAC sizing methods or the requirement that Title 24 calculations are unnecessary.
The source decision concerns electrical as-built concurrence documentation and does not change the separate mechanical drawing deliverable.
The source decision concerns electrical as-built concurrence documentation and does not change the separate plumbing drawing deliverable.
